Specification: This module is a small test specification for definability of infix operators with alias-like symbolic names. It declares a single variable x, defines several custom binary operators that all return their left operand, and uses them in the Next action to test that such operators can appear in action formulas. The spec is not a full temporal verification model with a Spec formula; instead it contains Init and Next plus TLC Print calls in Init, and comments indicate that several related operator tests were commented out because of TLC bugs.
